description.zh: RSA证书文件上传OSS后，在OSS上的完整文件名。
description.en: The full file name of the RSA certificate file in OSS after it is uploaded to OSS.
The operating system type. Set this parameter to 1 for Android.

description.zh: 用户选择下载的系统应用包名。
description.en: The package name of the system application that the user selects to download.

description.zh: 下载AiCC Container应用时，用户选择的插件集合，支持多选，以json数组存储。
description.en: The collection of plugins selected by the user when downloading the AiCC Container application. Multiple selections are supported. The value is stored as a JSON array.

description.zh:
签名方式。取值：

- **customized**：自定义签名
- **platform**：由平台签名
description.en:
The signing method. Valid values:

- **customized**: custom signing
- **platform**: platform signing.

title.zh: 获取IoVCC系统应用下载信息
title.en: Obtain ioVCC system application download information

descriptions.zh: > 用户上传自己的证书文件(.rsa)，IoVCC根据用户上传的证书文件，生成对应的安全图片，并存储到用户下载的系统应用中。
descriptions.en: > Upload your certificate file (.rsa). IoVCC generates a corresponding security image based on the uploaded certificate file and stores it in the system application that you download.
